title: Meta’s new Muse Charm device may cost $300
lede: Meta plans to sell Muse Charm, the pocket-sized AI companion it teased at Connect, for $300, The Information reports; Meta did not deny the figure.

points: Muse Charm is a physical embodiment of Meta's Muse agent that users can carry or wear around the neck, talking to it and giving it commands.
Asked about the price, Meta said only that it would have more to share soon about its AI devices.
At $300 it sits close to Friend's AI wearable, which retails for $250.
Amazon's Bee Frontier, which transcribes conversations and tracks tasks, lists for $75 plus a $99 yearly subscription to connect it to a user's apps.
TechCrunch notes that AI wearables have struggled so far, pointing to the Humane Ai pin, even as companies keep iterating on the form.
